# Infrastructure Checklist: macOS Virtual Audio Driver MVP

**Purpose**: Requirement-quality gate for packaging, local lifecycle, future backend boundaries, and operational assumptions.
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are packaging requirements complete for Developer ID signing, notarization, installer package format, install, repair, rollback, update, uninstall, and restart-required states? [Completeness, Plan §Primary Dependencies, Spec §FR-023..FR-026]
- [x] CHK002 Are local storage requirements complete for encryption, size accounting, warning/critical thresholds, disk reserve, retention deadline, and purge state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010..FR-012, Data Model §LocalBufferItem]
- [x] CHK003 Are future backend boundaries complete enough to state that MediaScribe, MinIO, Postgres, Temporal, and Docker are out of this driver feature while preserving handoff hooks? [Completeness, Plan §Storage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Are audit-relevant events complete for install, update, repair, uninstall, permission changes, route verification, capture start/stop, buffer entry, upload failure, and local purge acknowledgement? [Completeness, Spec §Audit Impact]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the boundary between local network/server outage and local driver/passthrough failure unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are "server unavailable" and "network unavailable" local buffer states defined without implying backend upload implementation in this feature? [Clarity, Data Model §LocalBufferItem]
- [x] CHK007 Is the active-call update deferral requirement clear enough to guide installer and updater task generation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are installer and local artifact lifecycle requirements consistent with deletion truth and diagnostic redaction rules? [Consistency, Constitution §Deletion Truth, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK009 Are local-only scope statements consistent across plan, research, data model, and quickstart without accidentally adding server implementation tasks? [Consistency, Plan §Scale/Scope, Quickstart]

- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for preserving or truthfully reporting local capture/buffer state after desktop app restart? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
